title: Mathematics Grade 6 Teacher's Guide (Implemented from year 2015), NIE Department of Mathematics
notes: Published by NIE but downloaded from the Ministry of Education's e-thaksalawa site (moe.gov.lk), because nie.lk sits behind a Cloudflare bot challenge that curl cannot pass. Chapter 1 (pp. 1-17) is the full 2015 syllabus with competencies, competency levels, content, learning outcomes and periods. Chapter 2 (p. 18) is the lesson sequence. Chapter 3 (pp. 19-120) has lesson plans with assessment criteria. Linked from the e-thaksalawa 'Mathematics - Grade - 06' course (course id 288, resource 42092).
